description.value: The Ambleside BC Liquor Store on Marine Drive is one of 198 government-operated BCLIQUOR retail locations across British Columbia, stocking wine, spirits, beer, ciders, coolers, and non-alcoholic products. It sits on a key North Shore cycling corridor, making it a convenient resupply stop for touring cyclists. OSM tagging records wheelchair accessibility for this two-storey commercial building.

address.value: 1434 Marine Drive, North Vancouver, BC V7T 1B7

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 65m; rack (4 spaces) at 66m; bollard (18 spaces) at 100m. Total: 26 spaces.
